scope: Read-only quality screening of the fixed 170 URLs plus exact publication dates recovered from existing cached HTML only. No network fetch, model fit, prediction labels, NAV or 2026 data read.

support_gate.rule: At least30 distinct source-verified issuer/date events and10 dates in each split; otherwise data limitation report, no fit
support_gate.interpretation: Source quality review is complete, but minimum event support is not met separately in each split; no fit.

date_policy.accepted: Exact publisher publication metadata, JSON-LD datePublished, dated publisher issue/masthead, or explicitly labeled publication time in cached page DOM.
date_policy.excluded: Body/event/footnote/fiscal/report-period dates, research-report cover/report dates without separate publication evidence, page footers, modified/updated timestamps, related links, or issuer tags alone.
known_corrections: SZSE.000002: cached 2025-01-04 corrected to visible publisher date 2025-02-12 15:10; price recap rejected.
SHSE.600989: cached 2025-01-12 corrected to publisher epoch 2023-01-06 18:32:12+08:00; Jan12 is event date; reject.
date_policy.source_vs_event: source_date is publisher publication date only; underlying event/fiscal/report date is separately noted and never substituted.

entity_content_policy.accepted: Explicit issuer/controlled-subsidiary event or company-specific results/operations/investment/financing/buyback/ownership/listing action.
entity_content_policy.rejected: Broad market/sector opinion, price recap, stock picks, generic robot/company lists, related-link boilerplate or mismatched entity without direct body evidence.
entity_content_policy.uncertain: Material event plausible but first-public issuer/version chain or investable-universe scope is not established.

vintage_limit: The accepted source pages have current publication date and fetched HTML SHA; first historical archive vintage is unverified. This is not a historically version-certified or licensed corpus.
limits: No fitting or price outcome tests were run.
Downstream must join the frozen historical eligible pool; this review did not inspect labels or outcomes.
No claim of NLP predictive value follows from the support-gate result.
